en.title: Marvel Rivals Cleans Up Visual Clutter, Making Action Easier to Follow
en.summary: NetEase has deployed a new patch for its hero shooter, Marvel Rivals, specifically targeting visual effects to reduce battlefield chaos. This update aims to improve clarity and player experience amidst increasingly intense team-based combat.
en.body:
The vibrant, chaotic battlefields of **Marvel Rivals** are getting a much-needed dose of clarity. NetEase has rolled out a new patch designed to "cut down on battlefield chaos," a move that should be music to the ears of players struggling to keep track of the high-octane action. As new heroes, abilities, and Team-Ups are introduced, the visual noise on screen has become a significant challenge, making it difficult to react effectively to enemy Ultimates or even just track opponents.

This latest update tackles that issue head-on by refining the visual effects of several heroes' abilities and many Team-Ups. The goal is to tone down the more overwhelming visual spectacles, ensuring that the action remains readable even during the most intense moments. In a game where split-second decisions and precise aiming are paramount, the ability to clearly see what's happening is not just a preference, but a necessity for competitive play. This focus on visual clarity is a positive step for a title that thrives on its dynamic, team-based combat.

## A Cleaner Battlefield for Superpowered Brawls

The constant influx of new content in **Marvel Rivals**, including characters like Jubilee and the upcoming Hood, alongside exciting Team-Up abilities, has undoubtedly enriched the gameplay. However, it has also led to a situation where the screen can become a dazzling, and sometimes disorienting, explosion of effects. This patch signifies NetEase's awareness of this growing problem and their proactive approach to addressing it. By carefully adjusting the visual presentation of abilities, the developers are aiming to create a more polished and accessible experience for both seasoned veterans and newcomers.

> "things have become a tad too intense when there are a lot of abilities on your screen, and keeping up with the action has been a challenge even for those who’ve been playing this one for a while. Thankfully, NetEase seems to be aware of that particular problem, and its latest patch is a step in the right direction."

This sentiment, echoing the feelings of many players, highlights the importance of this update. A cleaner visual presentation will not only help players perform better by improving situational awareness but also enhance the overall enjoyment of the game, making those clutch plays feel more earned and less like a lucky guess amidst a visual storm.

## What's Next for Marvel Rivals

With **Marvel Rivals** continuing its development and live service, players can anticipate further refinements and content updates. While this patch focuses on visual clarity, future updates will likely bring more heroes, maps, and gameplay adjustments. The game is currently available on Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC, with Season 9 featuring Jubilee as a Strategist. The arrival of The Hood is also on the horizon, promising more strategic depth and exciting Team-Up opportunities.

content_raw: Marvel Rivals is inching ever closer to a collision course with the MCU’s Avengers: Doomsday , and things have been heating up quite a bit for the popular hero shooter with new characters, locations, and brand-new Team Up abilities being added into the mix. However, we’ll be the first to admit that things have become a tad too intense when there are a lot of abilities on your screen, and keeping up with the action has been a challenge even for those who’ve been playing this one for a while. Thankfully, NetEase seems to be aware of that particular problem, and its latest patch is a step in the right direction. It brings changes to the visual effects of several heroes’ abilities and many Team-Ups, toning things down and making the action easier to read. That’s important in a game where you’re going to keep track of multiple opponents and try to dodge any Ultimates ahead of time. We’re looking forward to more of these fixes and a cleaner look for a title that’s been a mainstay of ours when the itch for hero-shooting gets too much to ignore. Marvel Rivals is available for Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC. Season 9 is currently live, adding Jubilee as a new Strategist with The Hood coming further down the line.
